blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Robot manipulation models primarily reason from 2D observations while acting in the 3D physical world.
To bridge this gap, recent work has augmented robot data with geometric priors such as depth, point clouds, and 3D trajectories, while renderable 3D Gaussian representations provide another promising form of 3D supervision.
However, 3DGS representation is designed mainly for photometric fidelity and may not preserve real-world metric scale, particularly when the supplied camera extrinsics are unreliable.
We study the effect of extrinsic reliability and pose conditioning on feed-forward 3DGS, and propose a calibration-aware pipeline that anchors reconstructed scenes to the robot’s metric workspace.
Our experiments show that pose conditioning improves novel-view fidelity, while its geometric benefit depends on the reliability of the injected extrinsics.
Using this pipeline, we present a renderable, metric-pose-anchored dataset with scene-level reliability information for robot manipulation research. Our dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/wonguen/3DROID

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Robot manipulation is inherently geometric: grasping and placement require
reasoning about objects, free space, and motion in 3D. Explicit 3D
representations improve spatial reasoning over 2D observations [ 10 , 16 , 17 , 21 ] , motivating recent 3D annotations and renderable robot scenes [ 3 , 13 , 22 ] .
Unlike point- or token-based annotations, renderable scenes provide a view-consistent appearance model from which observations and occlusions can be generated at new camera poses, enabling visual augmentation and simulation without additional data collection [ 22 ] .
Such novel-view augmentation has also been shown to improve policy robustness
to unseen camera poses [ 13 ] .

blocks.en:
Constructing these representations at dataset scale favors feed-forward reconstruction.
Classical 3DGS optimizes each scene independently from its
available observations, making sparse robot views underconstrained and requiring repeated optimization over thousands of episodes [ 8 ] .
Feed-forward variants instead amortize reconstruction
across training scenes: their learned priors support inference from limited views, while a single forward pass avoids repeated per-scene optimization [ 7 , 11 , 18 , 19 ] .
This makes them a practical basis for constructing large-scale renderable robot datasets.

blocks.en:
These advantages address sparsity and computational cost, but not physical reliability.
Both classical and feed-forward 3DGS are developed primarily for
photorealistic novel-view synthesis.
For manipulation, however, synthesized observations are useful only if they remain consistent with the metric workspace in which robot states and actions are defined [ 17 ] .
A reconstruction may preserve appearance while silently moving surfaces or changing scene scale.
Moreover, camera calibrations in real-world robot datasets are not uniformly reliable,
so shipped poses cannot simply be treated as ground truth.
Whether the resulting scenes preserve metric scale therefore remains unclear,
and calibration must be validated independently of the reconstructor.

blocks.en:
Prior work addresses parts of this problem from complementary directions.
Geometry-aware Gaussian methods introduce surface constraints, stereo cues, or 3D priors to improve geometric stability [ 5 , 14 , 13 ] , while camera-refinement methods align visual observations with robot geometry [ 6 ] .
Yet these model- and calibration-level solutions do not by themselves specify how reliability should be communicated when reconstructions are released as data.
This leaves a dataset-level question: how can calibration suitability and reconstruction reliability be measured and exposed for each scene?

先前的工作是从互补方向解决这一问题的部分内容。
几何感知高斯方法引入了表面约束,立体提示,或3D前缀,以提高几何稳定性[5,14,13],而镜头改进方法则将视觉观测与机器人几何相配合[6].
然而,这些模型和校准级的解决方案本身并不具体说明在重建作为数据发布时应如何传达可靠性。
这就留下了一个数据集层面的问题:如何衡量和暴露每个场景的校准适宜性和重建可靠性?

blocks.en:
In this paper, we therefore build 3DROID by reconstructing DROID [ 9 ] with pose-conditioned feed-forward 3DGS and
separating photometric fidelity from physical consistency.
Building on robot–depth alignment used for camera refinement [ 6 ] , we validate calibration before reconstruction and separately assess geometric reliability afterward, together with measurement coverage.
This separates calibration suitability from reconstruction reliability.
We therefore release measured support rather than claim geometric ground truth or downstream policy gains.

blocks.en:
Explicit 3D observations improve spatial reasoning for manipulation. DP3 demonstrated this with sparse point cloud, and FP3 scaled point-cloud pretraining to DROID [ 16 , 20 ] .
DROID-3D added depth and point clouds,
while 4D-VLA and Lift3D-VLA incorporated temporal geometry [ 3 , 10 , 21 ] .
PointWorld and Robo3R further improved calibration and robot-frame alignment [ 6 , 17 ] . Yet these point- or token-based outputs lack a view-consistent appearance model. Unlike point observations, renderable scenes can synthesize view-consistent observations from new camera poses, expose viewpoint-dependent visibility, and support data augmentation or visual simulation without recollecting demonstration.
RoboSnap builds layered mesh–Gaussian scenes from a single image, but does
not provide measured per-scene reconstruction reliability [ 22 ] .
This leaves open how to construct renderable robot scenes while explicitly measuring their metric alignment and reconstruction reliability.
blocks.zh:
明确的3D观测改进了用于操纵的空间推理. DP3用稀疏的点云演示了这一点,FP3将点云预训缩放到DROID [16, 20].
DROID-3D增加了深度和点云,
而4D-VLA和Felft3D-VLA结合了时间几何[3,10,21].
PointWorld和Robo3R进一步提高了校准和机器人帧对齐[6,17]. 然而,这些基于点或符号的输出缺乏一个与视图一致的外观模型。 与点观测不同的是,可渲染的场景可以合成来自新相机姿势的符合视距的观测,暴露视距依赖的能见度,并支持数据增强或视觉模拟而无需重新收集演示.
RoboSnap从一个单一的图像中构建层次化的网格-古西的场景,但确实
不提供测量的每层重建可靠性[22]。
这使得在明确测量其度量配比和重建可靠性的同时,如何构建可渲染的机器人场景变得开放.

blocks.en:
Whereas per-scene 3DGS requires time-consuming optimization [ 8 ] ,
feed-forward methods leverage learned priors to reconstruct scenes from sparse views in a single pass [ 1 , 7 ] .
Regardless of reconstruction strategy, 3DGS is designed primarily for photorealistic novel-view rendering.
Yet photorealism and manipulation readiness are different objectives: novel-view fidelity does not guarantee metric scale, robot-frame alignment, or reliable geometry.
Pose-conditioned PixelSplat, MVSplat, and DepthSplat improve matching and depth estimation but assume reliable calibration [ 1 , 2 , 15 ] . NoPoSplat and AnySplat remove pose inputs, while YoNoSplat handles variable posed or unposed inputs and ZipSplat compresses the representation [ 7 , 11 , 18 , 19 ] . GenSplat applies this pose-free paradigm to robotic view augmentation, but evaluates DROID reconstruction only qualitatively without testing robot-frame alignment [ 13 ] . We instead audit calibration and evaluate rendering separately from stereo-supported geometry.
blocks.zh:
而人均场景3DGS需要耗时的优化[8],
feed-forward 方法利用学到的前科,在单传中从稀少的视野中重建场景[1,7].
无论重建战略如何,3DGS主要设计为摄影现实主义小说-视觉渲染.
然而,光现实主义和操纵准备是不同的目标:新观点的忠诚不能保证尺度、机器人框的一致或可靠的几何。
Pose-conducted PixelSplat,MVSplat,和深度Splat改进匹配和深度估计,但假设可靠的校准[1,2,15]. 无 PoSplat 和 AnySplat 删除设置输入,而 YoNoSplat 手柄可变或未配置输入,ZipSplat 压缩表示 [7, 11, 18, 19]. GenSplate将这种无假象范式应用于机器人视图增强,但只评价DROID重建的质量,而没有测试机器人帧对齐[13]. 相反,我们审计校准 和评价渲染 与立体支持的几何。

blocks.en:
We evaluate ZipSplat [ 11 ] and
YoNoSplat [ 18 ] at their native resolutions. Baseline is pose-free
with DROID extrinsics, whereas Ours is pose-conditioned with refined rig
extrinsics. We report geometric results for both backbones to assess whether
the same trend holds across models. In pose-free runs, the backbone reconstructs the scene from RGB alone and
predicts its own camera frame. The selected extrinsics are applied only
after reconstruction to register this predicted frame and place the held-out
camera for evaluation. They are not network inputs.

blocks.en:
Photometric evaluation reconstructs from ext1L , ext1R , and ext2L , and reports PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS on held-out ext2R .
Because the feed-forward backbones use the first input view as their frame coordinate, we place ext1L first and hold out ext2R , which has the largest viewpoint separation from this anchor and thus provides a more discriminative evaluation [ 7 , 12 ] .
Geometric evaluation separately reconstructs from all four exterior views and reports robot-surface depth error and dense disagreement with classical stereo [ 4 ] , both with coverage.
The wrist stream is excluded from both evaluations.
Dense stereo applies consistency and low-texture filtering and is treated as input-view agreement, not ground truth.
All reported p-values are from two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank tests on paired per-scene differences, with the scene as the unit of variability.

几何评价从所有四种外观和报告机器人表面深度误差和与古典立体声的密集分歧分别重建[4],两者都有覆盖.

Dense立体声应用一致性和低纹理过滤,并作为输入-视图协议处理,而不是地面真理.
所有报道的p值均来自双侧威尔科克逊在对偶的单场差异上的签名排名测试,场景为可变单位.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 讨论和限制

blocks.en:
3DROID currently reconstructs a single static frame from four exterior views
and measures geometry only where robot-surface or stereo support is available.
Additional well-calibrated views may reduce sparse-view ambiguity, but we do
not isolate this effect. We exclude the wrist stream because its narrow field
of view and large domain gap from stationary cameras are
poorly matched to current feed-forward backbones.
Adapting these models to mixed observations from exterior and wrist cameras,
or fine-tuning them on robot data with metric pose, stereo, kinematic, and CAD
supervision, is promising future work.
A natural extension is to expand 3DROID from static snapshots to temporally
consistent 4D scenes that could provide dynamic context to robot learning
models.
We do not claim full-scene geometric ground truth or downstream manipulation
improvements.

不要孤立这种效果。 我们排除了手腕流 因为它的狭长领域

监督,是未来工作的希望。
一个自然的延伸是将3DROID从静态快照扩展为时空快照

模特儿们

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
To complement 2D-centric robot manipulation data with explicit 3D scene information,
we studied how to construct 3D Gaussian representations anchored to the metric scale and coordinate frame of real-world workspaces.
Our experiments show that pose conditioning constrains global similarity ambiguity,
while its outcome depends critically on the reliability of the injected extrinsics and does not alone guarantee metric geometry.
We therefore assess physical consistency separately through coverage-aware agreement between rendered depth,
classical stereo, and kinematically localized robot geometry.
Based on these findings, we introduce 3DROID, a metric-pose-anchored dataset that provides renderable robot scenes together with measured calibration and reconstruction-reliability information.
blocks.zh:
为了用明确的3D场景信息来补充以2D为中心的机器人操纵数据,
我们研究了如何构建基于度量尺度的3D高斯代表,并协调现实世界工作空间的框架。
我们的实验显示, 构成条件 制约全球相似性模糊,
其结果主要取决于注射外观的可靠性,而不能仅仅保证测量几何。
因此,我们通过在深度之间达成覆盖意识协议,分别评估物理上的一致性,
古典立体声, 和动能局部机器人几何。
基于这些发现,我们引入了3DROID,这是一套可以提供可变的机器人场景以及测量的校准和重建可靠性资料的参数。

arrays exactly. PLY hashes are reported separately because atomic rasterization
need not be byte-identical across hardware.
